stories.title: Mobilisation dans la fonction publique : plus de 300 000 manifestants en France, 70 000 à Paris selon la CGT

en.title: Mobilisation in the civil service: more than 300,000 demonstrators in France, 70,000 in Paris according to the CGT
en.summary: Multiple French trade unions organised a demonstration demanding salary increases for public employees and adequate budgetary resources for public services.

stories.title: "Nous allons démonter cette manipulation" : le RN contre-attaque après les accusations d'antisémitisme visant Jordan Bardella

en.title: "We will dismantle this manipulation": the RN counter-attacks after accusations of antisemitism targeting Jordan Bardella
en.summary: Antisemitic remarks attributed to Jordan Bardella were published by Mediapart. The RN president denies the allegations, and his party characterises the accusations as a destabilisation attempt.

stories.title: Grève du 29 septembre : 300 000 personnes ont manifesté en France pour demander plus de moyens dans la fonction publique, selon la CGT

en.title: Strike on 29 September: 300,000 people demonstrated in France to demand more resources for the civil service, according to the CGT
en.summary: Over 170 gatherings took place across France following a call from multiple trade unions. Teachers participated in the demonstrations at rates varying by region.

stories.title: Les propos antisémites attribués à Jordan Bardella par Mediapart provoquent un tollé dans la classe politique, le RN fait front derrière son président

en.title: Antisemitic remarks attributed to Jordan Bardella by Mediapart provoke uproar in the political class, the RN closes ranks behind its president
en.summary: An investigative media outlet published antisemitic statements attributed to the RN's second-in-command. Political opponents of the far-right party, which leads in presidential polls, condemned the remarks as extremely serious.

stories.title: «Barbouzerie», «il devrait démissionner» : la classe politique s’enflamme après la révélation d’écrits antisémites attribués à Jordan Bardella

en.title: "Dirty tricks", "he should resign": political class erupts after revelation of antisemitic writings attributed to Jordan Bardella
en.summary: Mediapart published antisemitic statements allegedly written by Jordan Bardella when he was a young National Front member. Political figures called for his resignation, though Bardella disputed the accusations.

stories.title: Ecrits antisémites attribués à Jordan Bardella : "On ne va pas se laisser faire", lance Marine Le Pen, qui entend "contre-attaquer" face à Mediapart

en.title: Antisemitic writings attributed to Jordan Bardella: "We will not let this happen", says Marine Le Pen, who intends to "counter-attack" against Mediapart
en.summary: Mediapart published antisemitic messages from 2013 attributed to the current National Rally president. He announced filing a defamation lawsuit in response.

stories.title: Propos antisémites : Jordan Bardella dément les révélations de Mediapart

en.title: Antisemitic statements: Jordan Bardella denies Mediapart revelations
en.summary: Mediapart published antisemitic remarks attributed to Jordan Bardella and referenced his interest in ideologue Alain Soral. The National Rally leader denied the revelations and claimed they aimed to damage his political career before the presidential election.

stories.title: Jordan Bardella accusé d’antisémitisme : le RN fait front commun dans le complotisme

en.title: Jordan Bardella accused of antisemitism: National Rally shows united front in conspiracy thinking
en.summary: Following Mediapart's publication of hateful statements allegedly made by the MEP, party leaders accused the outlet of manipulation and dirty tricks.

stories.title: Jordan Bardella dénonce "les prémices d'une guerre totale" contre le RN après les révélations de Mediapart sur les écrits antisémites qui lui sont attribués

en.title: Jordan Bardella denounces "beginnings of total war" against National Rally after Mediapart revelations on antisemitic writings attributed to him
en.summary: Marine Le Pen stated the National Rally would not accept the allegations and pledged to investigate who orchestrated the revelations following Mediapart's publication of antisemitic statements attributed to Bardella.

stories.title: Marine Le Pen dit sa "confiance absolue" en Jordan Bardella après des accusations d'antisémitisme

en.title: Marine Le Pen says she has "absolute confidence" in Jordan Bardella after antisemitism accusations
en.summary: Marine Le Pen expressed confidence in Jordan Bardella following Mediapart's publication of antisemitic remarks attributed to him. Le Pen stated the National Rally would not accept the accusations and would demonstrate who was behind what she called manipulation.

stories.title: Écrits antisémites attribués à Jordan Bardella : «On veut m’assassiner politiquement», déclare le président du RN

en.title: Antisemitic writings attributed to Jordan Bardella: "They want to assassinate me politically", declares the National Rally president
en.summary: The National Rally president, facing antisemitism accusations, claims they are intended to undermine his political future.

stories.title: Enquête de « Mediapart » : Jordan Bardella nie en bloc les propos antisémites et évoque « les prémices d’une guerre totale » contre le RN

en.title: Mediapart investigation: Jordan Bardella completely denies antisemitic remarks and evokes "the beginnings of total war" against the RN
en.summary: Mediapart published antisemitic messages from 2013 attributed to Jordan Bardella when he was a young National Front activist. The National Rally president denies the allegations entirely and has announced he will file a defamation lawsuit.

stories.title: Correction des copies par IA : la start-up lyonnaise Ed.ai vise les universités américaines

en.title: AI essay correction: Lyon-based start-up Ed.ai targets American universities
en.summary: EdTech company Ed.AI raised 5 million euros to deploy its artificial intelligence-powered essay correction and exercise generation tool in secondary and higher education in France and the United States.

stories.title: Premier vol de l’A350F, l’arme de reconquête d’Airbus dans le très dynamique marché du fret

en.title: First flight of the A350F, Airbus's weapon to recapture the dynamic cargo market
en.summary: Airbus conducted the first flight of its A350F cargo aircraft, designed to compete in the lucrative freight market against older Boeing planes. The aircraft emphasizes energy efficiency and is expected to enter service by the end of 2027.

stories.title: Thierry Cozic (candidat PS à la présidence de la commission des finances du Sénat) : « Pour doter la France d’un budget, l’exécutif devra sortir de son couloir »

en.title: Thierry Cozic (PS candidate for Senate Finance Committee presidency): "To provide France with a budget, the executive will have to step out of its corridor"
en.summary: A re-elected Socialist senator is running to lead the Senate finance committee and outlined his priorities regarding taxation, green transition financing, and local government. He also detailed conditions for reaching a compromise on the 2027 budget.

stories.title: En Gironde, la saison touristique lourdement plombée par un été 2026 suffocant

en.title: In Gironde, the tourist season heavily hit by a suffocating summer 2026
en.summary: Wildfires and heat waves damaged tourism activity in Gironde and Landes regions, causing an immediate loss of 190 million euros in July and August. A September recovery partially offset the damage, though broader economic impacts remain significant.

stories.title: Souveraineté et défense : qui financera l'industrie française ?

en.title: Sovereignty and defense: who will finance French industry?
en.summary: French defense assets are attracting growing interest from foreign buyers in an unprecedented geopolitical context. Small and medium-sized defense companies face complex challenges involving valuation gaps, delayed domestic financing mobilization, and increased state oversight.
